value.rationale: PASS: The naturally motivated family with two prime divisors is a missing mixed-prime-power case in an active prime-base congruence problem. The exact all-e iff test separates independent q-adic digit obstructions from p-adic Teichmüller obstructions; the first three layers collapse to one fixed binomial, and the fourth layer has a genuine correction. The result produces and directly checks a nontrivial prime-cube example n=3875 and two squared examples. A finite complete criterion for natural parameters is mathematically useful without an infinitude theorem.
